-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies WebSocket connectivity to backend.

get-project.name: get-project
get-project.description: Get project detail + its board columns. Returns: { project: { projectId, name, description, context, status, boardId, createdAt }, board: { boardId, columns: [{ columnId, slug, name, position }] } }. Use list-tasks to enumerate tasks.

list-projects.name: list-projects
list-projects.description: List projects in a workspace. Returns: { workspaceId, projects: [{ projectId, name, description, status, boardId, taskCount, activeAgentCount, createdAt }], nextCursor? }. Paginated: default 50, max 200. Use get-project for full detail + board columns.

params.workspaceId: Workspace ID (optional, defaults to execution workspace)

get-task.name: get-task
get-task.description: Get task detail + sub-tasks. Returns: { task: { taskId, title, description, columnName, columnSlug, priority, tags, assigneeName, running, stopRequested, dependencies, progressNotes, projectName, parentTaskTitle? }, subTasks: [...], agents }.

params.fields: Custom subset of fields for task + subTasks

list-tasks.name: list-tasks
list-tasks.description: List tasks in a project. Returns: { projectId, projectName, tasks: [{ taskId, title, columnName, columnSlug, priority, archived, tags, running, assigneeName, assigneeAvatarUrl }], agents, nextCursor? }. Paginated: default 50, max 200. For agent-view of own tasks use get-my-tasks (runner MCA).

params.tags: Return only tasks that have ALL these tags (optional)
params.fields: Custom subset of fields to return (overrides default whitelist)

list-board-agents.name: list-board-agents
list-board-agents.description: List agents in the workspace with access to board-manager or board-runner apps. Returns: { agents: [{ agentId, name, fullName, role, avatarUrl, capabilities }], nextCursor? }. Paginated: default 50, max 200.

create-project.name: create-project
create-project.description: Create a project with an associated Kanban board in a workspace. Returns: { project: { projectId, workspaceId, name, status, boardId }, board: { boardId, columns: [...] } }. Default columns: Backlog, To Do, In Progress, Blocked, Review, Done.

params.workspaceId: Workspace ID (optional, defaults to execution workspace)
params.name: Project name

create-task.name: create-task
create-task.description: Create a task on a project board. Defaults to Backlog column. Returns: { task: { taskId, title, columnId, priority, tags, assignedAgentId } }. Use batch-create-tasks to create many atomically.

params.title: Task title
params.instructions: Full task instructions (markdown — detailed specs, context, steps)

batch-create-tasks.name: batch-create-tasks
batch-create-tasks.description: Create multiple tasks atomically (all succeed or all fail). Max 100 per call. Returns: { projectId, tasks: [{ taskId, title, columnId, priority, tags }], count }. Use create-task for a single task.

update-task.name: update-task
update-task.description: Partial update of task properties. Omitted fields unchanged. Returns: { task: { ...TASK_FIELDS } }. To move a task between columns use move-task. To assign an agent use assign-task.

params.title: New title
params.description: New short description (plain text, max ~1000 chars)
params.instructions: New instructions (markdown — detailed specs, context, steps)

archive-task.name: archive-task
archive-task.description: Archive or restore a task (manager action). archived=true takes the task out of the active board (done / cancelled / discarded); archived=false restores it and triggers autoplay rescheduling. Returns: { task: { ...TASK_FIELDS } }.

params.archived: true = archive, false = restore to active board
params.archiveNote: Optional note explaining why the task was archived

archive-project.name: archive-project
archive-project.description: Archive a project (soft-delete) and all its non-archived tasks. Only admin/owner can archive. Idempotent — if already archived, returns the project. Returns: { project: { ...PROJECT_FIELDS } }.

params.archiveNote: Optional note explaining why the project was archived

update-project.name: update-project
update-project.description: Partial update of project properties (name, description, context). context is injected into agent system prompts when working on this project (markdown supported). Returns: { project: { ...PROJECT_FIELDS } }.

params.name: New name
params.context: Project context injected into agent system prompts (architecture notes, coding standards, etc.). Markdown supported.

update-board-config.name: update-board-config
update-board-config.description: Update the board execution config for a project. The config object is passed as-is to the board. Currently reserved for future auto-dispatcher settings. Returns: { projectId, config }.

params.config: Board config object (passed as-is to the board document)

move-task.name: move-task
move-task.description: Move a task to a different column on the board. Returns: { task: { ...TASK_FIELDS } } (includes columnName + columnSlug after move). Use list-board-subscriptions + subscribe-to-board to get notified when tasks move.

params.position: Position within the column (optional, defaults to end)

assign-task.name: assign-task
assign-task.description: Assign or unassign an agent to a task. Pass agentId to assign, omit or null to unassign. Returns: { task: { ...TASK_FIELDS } }.

params.agentId: Agent ID (omit or null to unassign)

start-task.name: start-task
start-task.description: Start a task: moves to in_progress, creates a headless conversation with the assigned agent, sends the task description as the first message, and links the conversation to the task. Returns: { task: { ...TASK_FIELDS, channelId }, channelId }. Optional override of agent or prompt.

params.agentId: Optional agent override. Reassigns the task before starting.
params.prompt: Optional custom prompt. Overrides the default task description as the first message.

link-conversation.name: link-conversation
link-conversation.description: Link an existing conversation (channel) to a task. Replaces any previously linked channel. Returns: { task: { ...TASK_FIELDS, channelId } }. Use start-task to link a new headless conversation instead.

add-progress-note.name: add-progress-note
add-progress-note.description: Post a progress note on a task (manager action). Notes are visible on the task detail and the board. Returns: { task: { ...TASK_WITH_PROGRESS_FIELDS } }. Runner agents should use the board-runner add-progress-note instead.

delete-task.name: delete-task
delete-task.description: Permanently delete a task. Sub-tasks become top-level tasks. Linked conversations are NOT deleted. Irreversible. Returns: { taskId, deleted: true }.

delete-project.name: delete-project
delete-project.description: Permanently delete a project and all its tasks and board. Only workspace admin/owner can delete. Irreversible — prefer archive-project for soft-delete. Returns: { projectId, deleted: true }.

add-task-dependency.name: add-task-dependency
add-task-dependency.description: Add a dependency: after this call, taskId depends on dependsOnTaskId (dependsOnTaskId must complete first). Cycle detection runs automatically; if adding the edge would create a cycle, the call errors and affected tasks are marked circular_dependency. Returns: { task: { ...TASK_FIELDS, dependencies } }.

params.taskId: Task that gains the new dependency (the dependent task)
params.dependsOnTaskId: Task that taskId will depend on (must complete first)

remove-task-dependency.name: remove-task-dependency
remove-task-dependency.description: Remove a dependency between two tasks. Idempotent — if the dependency does not exist, the task is returned unchanged. Returns: { task: { ...TASK_FIELDS, dependencies } }.

params.taskId: Task that currently has the dependency
params.dependsOnTaskId: Task to remove from taskId's dependencies

get-task-dependencies.name: get-task-dependencies
get-task-dependencies.description: Get dependencies of a task (tasks that must complete before it can start). Returns: { taskId, dependencies: [{ taskId, title, columnSlug, priority, archived }], count, nextCursor? }. Paginated when large: default 50, max 200.

params.taskId: Task ID whose dependencies to list

set-agent-slots.name: set-agent-slots
set-agent-slots.description: Configure parallel execution slots for an agent in a project. slots=0 disables autoplay (also auto-disables playEnabled if it was on). slots≥1 enables the play button. Returns: { relationship: { agentId, projectId, slots, playEnabled, activeSlots } }. Use set-agent-play to toggle autoplay after setting slots.

set-agent-play.name: set-agent-play
set-agent-play.description: Toggle autoplay for an agent on a project. When enabled=true the agent auto-picks eligible To Do tasks up to its slot limit. Requires slots≥1 (use set-agent-slots first). Disabling does NOT cancel tasks already running. Returns: { relationship: { agentId, projectId, slots, playEnabled } }.

subscribe-to-board.name: subscribe-to-board
subscribe-to-board.description: Subscribe the current conversation to real-time board events. Events (task moves, status changes, progress notes, dependency changes, autoplay toggles) are delivered to the conversation as they happen. Use filter to narrow events. Returns: { subscription: { subscriptionId, boardId, filter, createdAt } }. Use unsubscribe-from-board to stop.

params.filter: Optional filter to narrow delivered events

unsubscribe-from-board.name: unsubscribe-from-board
unsubscribe-from-board.description: Cancel this conversation's subscription to board events for a specific board. Idempotent — if no subscription exists, returns { boardId, unsubscribed: true } unchanged. Returns: { boardId, unsubscribed: true }.

list-board-subscriptions.name: list-board-subscriptions
list-board-subscriptions.description: List active board subscriptions for the current conversation. Returns: { subscriptions: [{ subscriptionId, boardId, boardName, filter, createdAt }], nextCursor? }. Paginated: default 50, max 200.

get-board-status.name: get-board-status
get-board-status.description: Operational status of a board: per-agent workload + summary. Returns: { boardId, boardName, agents: [{ agentName, slots, playEnabled, tasksInProgress, tasksInReview, tasksBlocked, tasksToDo }], summary: { total, byColumn, blockedTasks } }. Use to identify bottlenecks.

stop-task.name: stop-task
stop-task.description: Send cooperative stop signal to a running task (task.running=true). The assigned runner agent finishes its current step, then moves the task to Blocked. Cooperative — the signal is processed at the next runner turn. Only managers should call this. Returns: { taskId, stopRequested: true }.

params.taskId: Task ID of a running task
params.reason: Optional human-readable reason delivered to the runner

subscribe-to-events.name: subscribe-to-events
subscribe-to-events.description: Subscribe the current conversation to MCA events on a topic. Events matching the topic are delivered to the conversation as they happen. Use rules to narrow events. Returns: { subscription: { id, topic, channelId, rules, mode, createdAt } }. Use unsubscribe-from-events to stop.

params.channelId: Channel ID to receive events in (defaults to current conversation)
params.rules: Optional filter rules to narrow delivered events
params.mode: Delivery mode: notify = silent notification, wake = trigger agent response turn. Default: notify

unsubscribe-from-events.name: unsubscribe-from-events
unsubscribe-from-events.description: Delete a channel event subscription by ID. Returns: { deleted: true }.

list-event-subscriptions.name: list-event-subscriptions
list-event-subscriptions.description: List active event subscriptions for a channel. Returns: { subscriptions: [{ id, topic, channelId, rules, mode, createdAt, lastActivityAt }], nextCursor? }. Paginated: default 50, max 200.

params.channelId: Channel ID to list subscriptions for (defaults to current conversation)

name: Board Manager
description: Full board management capabilities for coordinator and supervisor agents. Provides complete control over projects, boards, and tasks — including creating, assigning, updating, moving, and deleting tasks. Designed for agents that orchestrate work across multiple workers, manage priorities, and oversee the full lifecycle of a project board.

changelog.notes: Create and organize projects and Kanban boards, manage tasks and dependencies, assign agents, and orchestrate autonomous work
